record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.original_question: Let Auth^{<∞}(I, λ) be the space of Lebesgue measure-preserving automorphisms of the interval with finite entropy, and let Diff(T^n, λ^n) be the space of Lebesgue measure-preserving diffeomorphisms of the n-torus. Is there a Borel map G from Auth^{<∞}(I, λ) into the disjoint union over n of Diff(T^n, λ^n) such that each system (I, λ, T) is measure-isomorphic to (T^n, λ^n, G(T))?

evidence.quote: Let (I, λ) be the interval Lebesgue space and (Πn, λn) the n-torus Lebesgue space. We have that Auth<∞(I, λ) is the space of (Lebesgue) measure-preserving automorphisms of I with finite entropy and Diff(Πn, λn) the space of (Lebesgue) measure-preserving diffeomorphisms of Πn.
Question 5.1 (Rodriguez Hertz). Is there a Borel map G : Auth<∞(I, λ) → ⋃n Diff(Πn, λn), such that (I, λ, T ) is isomorphic to (Πn, λn, G(T )).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(I,\lambda)$ denote the unit interval equipped with Lebesgue measure, and for each integer $n\ge 1$ let $(\mathbb{T}^n,\lambda^n)$ denote the $n$-dimensional torus equipped with Lebesgue measure. Denote by $\mathrm{Auth}^{<\infty}(I,\lambda)$ the standard Borel space of Lebesgue measure-preserving automorphisms of $I$ that have finite Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy, and by $\mathrm{Diff}(\mathbb{T}^n,\lambda^n)$ the standard Borel space of $C^\infty$ Lebesgue measure-preserving diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{T}^n$.

Does there exist a Borel measurable map
$$G:\mathrm{Auth}^{<\infty}(I,\lambda)\;\longrightarrow\;\bigsqcup_{n\ge 1}\mathrm{Diff}(\mathbb{T}^n,\lambda^n)$$
such that for every $T\in\mathrm{Auth}^{<\infty}(I,\lambda)$, if $G(T)\in\mathrm{Diff}(\mathbb{T}^n,\lambda^n)$ then the measure-preserving systems $(I,\lambda,T)$ and $(\mathbb{T}^n,\lambda^n,G(T))$ are measure-theoretically isomorphic?
artifact.status_search_result: The question, attributed to F. Rodriguez Hertz, concerns a Borel-uniform version of the smooth realization problem. The general smooth realization problem for finite-entropy systems is a well-known open problem in ergodic theory, and no Borel selector of the kind asked for appears in the literature. Searches reveal only partial smooth realization results (e.g., Gerber–Katok pseudo-Anosov constructions, slow-entropy realizations for commuting transformations) but no resolution of this Borel-map version.

status_evidence.title: Slow entropy type invariants and smooth realization of commuting measure-preserving transformations
status_evidence.snippet: Partial smooth realization results for commuting measure-preserving transformations.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial smooth realization results are known; the general realization problem (let alone a Borel-uniform version) remains unsolved.

status_evidence.title: Recent Progress in Dynamics, MSRI Publications, problem list
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems in smooth dynamics and realization of measure-preserving systems.
status_evidence.claim: Smooth realization of finite-entropy ergodic systems is listed among open problems.
